script:
mkdir -p "$F/gone" printf '

qa-f16-gone

\n' > "$F/gone/index.html" GID=$(control-agent-server conversation start --no-run --tools none --no-autotitle --workspace "$F/gone" --print-id) control-agent-server api GET "/$GID/workspace" --expect 200 --check . contains qa-f16-gone rm -rf "$F/gone" control-agent-server api GET "/$GID/workspace" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'Workspace directory does not exist' --save F16.workspace-dir-missing/gone control-agent-server api GET "/$GID/workspace/index.html" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'Workspace directory does not exist' mkdir -p "$F/gone" printf '

qa-f16-back

\n' > "$F/gone/index.html" control-agent-server api GET "/$GID/workspace" --expect 200 --check . contains qa-f16-back --save F16.workspace-dir-missing/back
